name: set_token_filter
description: Update a paged-vocabulary bitmask for one batch row. vocab_mask is an int32 [batch, n_words] bitmask (word = token_id >> 5, bit = token_id & 31), token_ids is a Python list of token ids, and batch_idx selects a row (negative indices wrap). If reset_vocab_mask is true the selected row is first set to 0 when is_allowed, otherwise to -1; then each token sets its bit with atomic OR when is_allowed or clears it with atomic AND when not. The native function writes into vocab_mask (or into a contiguous copy if the supplied tensor is non-contiguous) and returns that tensor. Empty token_ids is allowed and still performs the reset. Suites exercise int32 masks, list token ids and both allow/deny modes.
